title: gp-quantum-bottleneck-unet: Source code and results for a five-seed comparison of a quantum bottleneck with size-matched classical and trigonometric layers in U-Net mammographic mass segmentation
description: Code, protocols, fold assignments, crop parameters and per-image results for the study of global versus patch-wise quantum bottlenecks in U-Net mass segmentation: a simulated 4-qubit circuit compared with size-matched Dense(4) and trigonometric layers and an identity mapping in the same slot, trained on CBIS-DDSM with patient-level cross-validation, five seeds and two learning-rate schedules (450 runs), and tested on a frozen CBIS-DDSM cohort, DMID, CSAW-S and CDD-CESM, with code-replacement tests, initialization and weight-change audits and analyses of the circuit function class, entanglement and noise.
